strings.jp:
お前が諸悪の根源だな?
来い!　ぶっ飛ばしてやるぜ!
strings.en:
You're the root of all evil?
C'mon! I'll kick your ass!

strings.jp:
フフフ…私をぶっ飛ばす?
面白い、試してみましょう!
strings.en:
Heh heh... Kick my ass?
Amusing. Let's try it!

strings.jp:
…チッ…マズったか!?
みんな…後は頼んだぜ……
strings.en:
...Tch... Did I screw up!?
Guys... the rest is on you...

strings.jp:
悔いを残しながら…
お消えなさい……フフフ…
strings.en:
Vanish now... with all
your regrets... Heh heh...

strings.jp:
良く頑張った方だと…
言ってあげましょう。フフフ……
strings.en:
I'll grant that you put up
a good fight. Heh heh...

strings.jp:
おらおらおらーッ!
テメェだけは許さねーッ!
strings.en:
Take that! And that!
I ain't forgivin' you!

strings.jp:
な…何故……何故…
この私が……
